name: MuxPD TP4 numerical follow-up evidence (2026-10-25)
body:
Immutable evidence for the bounded MuxPD TP4 numerical follow-up on four verified 910B2 devices. Includes native controls, matched raw/group runs, two preserved collection failures, actual KV geometry discovery, complete captured rank-zero logits, compiler graphs and source/provenance snapshots.

This is diagnostic evidence, not a software release, official leaderboard submission, general quality qualification, or new throughput/goodput claim. The group callback coverage limit and its correction are retained. Quality and forced-pressure/performance evidence are not included in this v2 snapshot.

Report source: https://github.com/vLLM-HUST/vllm-hust-benchmark/tree/f9d8beeca4ebbcd26c027a2a780a290e2ad0e0d3/reports/muxpd-followup-20261025
